sections.lecture_material: Outer molecular terms fail near no-slip; introduce eta_w and u_w; shared inner velocity scale supported by described mean/rms data
sections.extension: Pressure can coexist with turbulence at leading order; common scale not uniform instantaneous wall asymptotics
sections.construction: Match inner region purpose to boundary conditions

sections.lecture_material: Continuity normal velocity, two equal-order advective terms, normalize by normal viscosity, inner Reynolds order1
sections.extension: Retain inner Reynolds factor before selecting balance; equality1 is unit convention, not exact flow theorem

sections.lecture_material: Integrate leading inner equation from wall to y; total molecular plus turbulent stress; approximate finite-Re interpretation
sections.extension: Exact residual integral at finite Re; approximate equations can be integrated; Couette exact finite-Re contrast and channel correction
sections.construction: General remainder bound and recurring pressure-driven channel

sections.lecture_material: Constant-stress layer and wall-shear inference away from wall, measurement/grid motivation
sections.extension: Inference error from molecular share and total-stress variation; near-wall information not recoverable without closure

sections.lecture_material: Define friction velocity, viscous length, U+ and y+, multiple Reynolds definitions
sections.extension: Positive shear convention, absolute magnitude for signed wall traction, separation degeneracy, y+ based on actual distance not viscous length fixed1
sections.construction: Air wall-unit conversion and resolution sensitivity

sections.lecture_material: Outer flow versus outer layer, turbulent/non-turbulent interface, inner/outer overlap and rough boundaries

sections.construction: Primary opening-summary comparison and empty-overlap test
